delivery.outcome: Generate one valid atomic t2c.event-log/v1 artifact for every persisted pipeline run
nonGoals: No GitHub event acquisition or workflow-level stream
No mutation of a completed pipeline log
No public interface, CLI, SDK, workflow or dependency change
No trusted approval derived from an LLM

architecture.decision: A dependency-free pipeline codec atomically publishes an immutable per-run logs.dsl.txt after manifest persistence; a later integration producer creates a separate workflow-level stream from GitHub evidence
dataChanges: Every persisted pipeline run gains logs.dsl.txt and manifest.files.eventLog
architecture.rollback: Remove event-log persistence and the registered manifest path; existing run artifacts remain readable

validation.evidence: The canonical fixture and negative structural/digest cases exercise one codec
Atomic publication, unsafe references and bounded values are tested
Succeeded, degraded and failed manifests each have a valid adjacent event log
Deterministic, repository-wide and container gates pass
